title: Live-Action In the Clear Moonlit Dusk Film Opens in Taiwan on November 20
content:
Taiwanese film distributor Cai Chang Asia began streaming a Chinese-subtitled trailer for the live-action film of Mika Yamamori 's In the Clear Moonlit Dusk ( Uruwashi no Yoi no Tsuki ) manga on Monday. The trailer reveals that the film will open in Taiwan on November 20.

Kodansha USA Publishing licensed the manga, and it describes the story:

Yoi Takiguchi has long legs, a deep voice, and a handsome face...in other words, Yoi is such a good-looking guy that most people don't notice or care that she is, in fact, a girl. Indeed, she's had the nickname "Prince" as long as she can remember. That is, until she met Ichimura-senpai...the only person who's really seemed to see her for herself. To her surprise, she's not sure how to handle this new relationship, especially when her newfound friend is a prince himself (and a guy prince, at that). The story of the two high school princes starts here!

Shunsuke Michieda (live-action My Love Mix-Up! TV series, live-action The Kindaichi Case Files series) stars as Kohaku Ichimura (right in photo right), and Seira Anzai (live-action Insomniacs After School film, live-action Trillion Game TV series) stars as Yoi Takiguchi (left).

Other cast members include Rintarō Mizusawa as Takuto Ohji, Yuna Hoshino as Nobara Tone, Sayu Suzukawa as Kotobuki Hibiya, Takato Ōkura as Sentarō Akane, Tatsumi Asa as Shun Kuwabatake, Yūki Yoda as Yoshiko, and Naohito Fujiki as Seiichi Takiguchi, Yoi's father.

Kentarō Takemura (live-action Trillion Game TV series) directed the film, and Yuichi Tokunaga (live-action Densha Otoko TV series) wrote the script. Shū Kanematsu ( My Next Life as a Villainess: All Routes Lead to Doom! , Aquarion: Myth of Emotions ) composed the music. TBS TV oversaw production at TBS Sparkle , and TOHO is distributing.

The film opened in Japan on October 23. The film ranked at #4 in its opening weekend. The film sold 141,000 tickets and earned 200,272,200 yen (about US$1.27 million) in its first three days.

Yamamori launched the manga in Dessert magazine in 2020. Kodansha published the manga's 11th compiled book volume on September 11. The manga will end with its 12th volume next spring.

The manga ranked #11 on the list of manga for female readers in the 2023 edition of Takarajimasha 's Kono Manga ga Sugoi! (This Manga Is Amazing!) guidebook.

The manga's anime adaptation premiered on January 11. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired in Japan.
author: ANN

title: Attack on Titan: The Final Season Anime's Hindi Dub Streams on Muse India YouTube Channel
content:
The channel also began streaming the Asteroid in Love television anime as a daily upload on the same day.

The Attack on Titan The Final Season anime premiered on NHK in December 2020 and aired for 16 episodes. Attack on Titan The Final Season Part 2 premiered with episode 76 on the NHK General channel in January 2022, and aired for 12 episodes.

Attack on Titan Final Season THE FINAL CHAPTERS aired originally as two specials in Japan. The first part aired as a one-hour special in March 2023. SIM returned to perform a new theme song, "Under the Tree."

The anime's finale premiered in November 2023 on the NHK General channel. The finale is 85 minutes long . Linked Horizon performed the theme song "Nisen-nen... Moshiku wa.... Niman-nen ato no Kimi e" (To You in 2,000... or... 20,000 Years From Now).

Attack on Titan Final Season THE FINAL CHAPTERS parts 1 and 2 also streamed in Japan in single-episode format, serving as episodes 88-94 of Attack on Titan The Final Season . These episodes had their own opening and ending theme sequences. Linked Horizon performed the opening theme song "Saigo no Kyojin" (The Last Titan) and Ai Higuchi performed the ending theme song "Itterasshai" (Have a Safe Trip).

Anime Times added Attack on Titan season 3 and Attack on Titan The Final Season in India in July 2024. It added the Hindi dub for Attack on Titan Final Season THE FINAL CHAPTERS in March 2025.

Attack on Titan The Movie: THE LAST ATTACK , a compilation film of Attack on Titan Final Season THE FINAL CHAPTERS , was released in Indian theaters on July 24. It opened in November 2024 for a three-week limited engagement in Japanese theaters. It sold 175,000 tickets and earned 249,435,720 yen (about US$1.59 million) in its first three days.

Hajime Isayama launched the original Attack on Titan manga in Kodansha 's Bessatsu Shōnen Magazine in 2009, and ended the series in April 2021. The manga's 34th and final compiled book volume shipped in June 2021. Kodansha USA Publishing released the manga in English digitally and in print, and released the 34th volume in October 2021.

title: Look Back Anime Film Wins Kineko Int'l Film Fest's Teens Feature Award
content:
The anime film of Chainsaw Man creator Tatsuki Fujimoto 's " Look Back " one-shot manga won the Kineko Grand Prix Teens Feature award at the Kineko International Film Festival in Tokyo on Tuesday. The category includes both Japanese and foreign films aimed at 13- to 18-year-olds, and judges of the same age decide the winner of the category.

The film opened in theaters in Japan in June 2024. It ranked at #2 in terms of ticket sales (but #1 in weekend earnings) in its opening weekend. The film sold 135,000 tickets and earned 227 million (about US$1.40 million) in its first three days.

GKIDS screened the anime film in October 2024 in North America. The film earned US$688,253 at the U.S. box office in its opening weekend.

Yūmi Kawai and Mizuki Yoshida star in the film. Kawai plays Fujino, a fourth grader who draws four-panel comics in the school newspaper. Yoshida plays Kyomoto, Fujino's classmate who has been skipping school.

Kiyotaka Oshiyama ( Flip Flappers ) directed the anime, and was also in charge of the screenplay and character designs. Oshiyama's Studio Durian produced the film. Singer urara performed the film's theme "Light song" by composer Haruka Nakamura .

Fujimoto debuted the one-shot manga on Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ in July 2021. The manga had over 2.5 million views on its first day. Viz Media and MANGA Plus launched the manga digitally in English. Viz Media published the manga in print in September 2022.

The manga inspired a live-action film that opened on September 11 in Japan. Hirokazu Kore-eda ( Shoplifters , Our Little Sister , Air Doll ) directed and edited the film, and also wrote the screenplay. GKIDS will release the film in theaters in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., and Ireland. The film will screen in select theaters in North America on December 30, followed by a wider release in theaters on January 15.

Fujimoto ( Fire Punch ) debuted the Chainsaw Man manga in Weekly Shonen Jump in December 2018 and ended its "first part," the "Kōan" (Public Safety) arc, in December 2020. The manga's second part, titled "Gakkō-hen" (School Arc), started on Shueisha 's Shonen Jump+ service in July 2022, and it ended on March 24 (March 25 in Japan).

title: Godzilla Minus Zero Earns Highest-Ever Opening Day for Live-Action Film in Japan
content:
TOHO announced on Wednesday that Godzilla Minus Zero , the new Godzilla film from Godzilla Minus One 's Takashi Yamazaki , has sold 590,000 tickets for 910 million yen (about US$5.75 million) in Japan in its opening day alone, setting a new record for the highest opening day earnings for a live-action film (among both foreign and domestic live-action films) in Japan.

The film had 201% higher opening day earnings than its predecessor Godzilla Minus One .

The film opened in Japan on Tuesday, November 3, which is "Godzilla Day" in Japan, celebrating the anniversary of the first Godzilla film's November 3, 1954 release. Godzilla Minus One similarly opened in Japan on November 3, 2023. (Godzilla Day fell on a Tuesday this year, but it is also the Japanese holiday known as Culture Day.)

The sequel is set in 1949, two years after the Godzilla Minus One film's story.

Min Tanaka ( 47 Ronin , live-action Rurouni Kenshin films) plays biologist Kanji Murakami. He joined returning cast members Ryūnosuke Kamiki (Koichi Shikishima), Minami Hamabe (Noriko Ōishi), and Hidetaka Yoshioka (Noda) from Godzilla Minus One . Also returning in the cast are Yūki Yamada (Shiro Mizushima), Kuranosuke Sasaki (Seiji Akitsu), Sakura Andō (Sumiko Ota), and Miō Tanaka (Tatsuo Ho tta).

Yamazaki returned as director, screenwriter, and VFX supervisor. Naoki Satō also returned to compose the music. Shirogumi Inc. handled the film's visual effects.

GKIDS and TOHO will release the film in North America on Friday, November 6. This is the first time a Japan-produced Godzilla film will open in Japan and in North America in the same week.

This is the first Japanese film to meet the standard to advertise itself as "filmed for IMAX." In addition to opening in Japan and North America, it will open in the same week in Latin America, Europe, Asia, the Middle East, Australia, and New Zealand. The companies stated they will announce additional international release dates at a later time. TOHO acquired GKIDS in October 2024.

Godzilla Minus One has earned more than US$116 million worldwide. According to Box Office Mojo, the film has earned an estimated US$57,144,669 in the United States. The film was the third highest-grossing foreign-language film in the United States as of 2024.

Netflix is streaming the film and Godzilla Minus One /Minus Color , the black-and-white version of the film, worldwide on Netflix . In North America, Godzilla Minus One and Godzilla Minus One /Minus Color are additionally available for digital rental and digital purchase on Amazon, Apple iTunes , Google Play , Microsoft , FandangoNOW/ VUDU , inDemand, XBOX, and Vubiquity. In Japan, the film is streaming exclusively (in color and monochrome) on Amazon Prime Video .

Godzilla Minus One won the Best Visual Effects award in the 96th Academy Awards in March 2024. The film is the first Japanese film to win in this category, and the first Godzilla film to be nominated for an Oscar.

Yamazaki's first English-language film Grandgear was originally slated to open on February 18, 2028, but Sony Pictures recently moved up its release date to January 14, 2028.

title: Mobile Suit Gundam Changed The Mecha Anime Game With This Look
content:
The removal of the face vents from the Gundam suits in Mobile Suit Gundam 00 changed the whole aura of the mechs. The face vents gave the robots a human element, as they looked similar to a mouth. The mouth made the machines look much less menacing. It obviously helped that the Gundams were the good guys in most of the prior anime , so the look disarmed a lot of viewers. Whereas, the mouthless introduction gave them a mysterious and shrouded vibe that clouded the intentions of the people piloting them.

It’s a great way to bring in the faction known as Celestial Being that the Gundams were a part of. The intentions of the group were unknown, but don’t seem wholly good. As it turned out, the group is a band of anti-heroes in some sense. They wanted to stop the wars around the world by intervening themselves. It’s essentially violence to stop violence, which is far from a perfect mission. It’s killing to stop the deaths of the innocent. Americans can definitely connect the dots from these Gundam pilots to the heroes in Gundam Wing . The heroes in that series were called assassins and somehow this group’s secretive aesthetic feels eerily similar.

Their New Appearance Was Ready For War

Throughout most Gundam series there are mobile suits that didn’t have anthropomorphic features, but they weren’t gundams either. They were mobile suits that featured visors or the iconic mono-eyes. Most of those units were seen as foot soldiers or innumerable fodder to throw at the opposing enemy. Usually, Gundams slice through mono-eye units in seconds, so they don’t carry the same significance as their stronger, main character counterparts.

Gundam 00 flipped this concept around, but it also built off some past models that featured mouthless mechs. Mobile Fighter G Gundam did a great job of denoting when fights were about to ratchet up with Shining Gundam. Most conflicts showed the Shining Gundam taking a beating in its normal form, which would then result in Domon Kashu’s anger transforming the robot into its super mode. This power-up split the mouth portion open and unveiled a bright red shroud face underneath. Shining Gundam would then use shining finger and usually win the battle.

American audiences gathered a baseline from the look that an expressionless face meant business. It always signified that the intensity of the fight was raised. In the same way, Gundam 00 introduced the units as far superior machines to the rest of the world’s militaries. Furthermore in this universe, Gundams hadn’t existed prior to the show, so it was a fresh start from a design standpoint.

Rogue Outfit Deserved Tougher Look

Celestial Being brought the hammer of unbiased justice down onto a warring world. It didn’t carry an allegiance to a particular country, and a faceless look fit that. They also drop in unannounced and exit the scene just as quickly giving them a spy vibe. They come in and accomplish their mission swiftly but don’t want to cause extensive, unneeded damage to anyone else.

Fair or unfair, they’re also labeled as “terrorists” to politicians across the world, so they fit from a narrative level too. They have a look that can be manipulated by anyone and act as threats to any country. This means nations have to band together and set aside their differences in order to stop a greater threat, which is exactly what Celestial Being wants. Did you like the new look of the gundams in Gundam 00 ? Let us know in the comments.

title: Seven Seas Licenses Led by Stars Manga, Melting Point Manhwa, 3 Audiobooks
content:
Seven Seas announced the following audiobook and manga licenses on Wednesday:

Title: 7th Time Loop: The Villainess Enjoys a Carefree Life Married to Her Worst Enemy! Short Story Collection audiobook Creators: Tōko Amekawa , Wan Hachipisu Narration: Sarah Gage Release Date: November 19 (Siren imprint) Summary: This handpicked selection showcases dozens of delightful tales, including tender moments between Arnold and Rishe not depicted in the main story and glimpses of characters who aren't often in the limelight. See what Oliver, Arnold's stalwart attendant, gets up to during his time off—and what his relationship is like with his lord's little brother. Peer into a world where Arnold and Rishe are nothing more than students at the same academy. A few tales even feature Rishe's past lives from the perspectives of those she was close to. In the longest story, written specifically for this collection, Rishe and Arnold go undercover…as a married couple! Will our heroine be able to keep her cool around her “beloved husband” long enough to avoid suspicion? Either way, it's bound to be amusing watching her try!

Title: The Dangers in My Heart – The Novel audiobook Creators: Kota Nozomi , Norio Sakurai , sune Narration: Clint Bickham , Katelyn Barr Release Date: November 26 (Siren imprint) Summary: Experience the world beyond the gaze of the story's usual narrator, Ichikawa Kyotaro–a dour teen hopelessly smitten with Yamada Anna, the prettiest girl in class. For the first time, fans can see events through the eyes of beloved side characters like the mischievous Moeko, a flustered Kanzaki, and even Yamada's mother. Plus, an exclusive story about the early days of Ichikawa and Yamada's relationship over summer break from a completely new perspective. These sweet, bite-sized stories are sure to satisfy longtime fans and newcomers alike!

Title: Beacon of Light in the Dark Sea audiobook Creator: Softcoral Narration: James Aaron Oh Release Date: December 17 (volume 1, Siren imprint) Summary: Humanity's hunger for resources has sent us where we were never meant to go--down into the crushing dark. The North Pacific International Undersea Station is a submerged labyrinth of labs, mining decks, and narrow living quarters where the sun never reaches.

Muhyeon, a dentist by trade, joins the station expecting routine work, but the eerie silence and the crew's increasingly unstable behavior quickly prove him wrong. From quirky to unsettling, every encounter makes one truth impossible to ignore: the danger isn't outside the station--it's already here.

Title: Led by Stars manga Creator: Abi Release Date: November 2027 (volume 1, Ghost Ship imprint) Summary: In the quiet town of Elwood, on the edge of the Great Dungeon of Dagonalia, former adventurer Arc works alongside Lily as a guild receptionist. But one day, a mysterious threat known only as the “Goblin Queen” appears, wiping out anything and everything that crosses her path while stealing women away. With danger looming over them, Arc must decide if he will take up his sword once more and embark on a deadly journey to protect the town—and most importantly, Lily. To Arc's surprise, Lily has been hiding something from Arc that could change everything between them!

Title: Melting Point manhwa Creator: Pibi Release Date: April 2028 ("Season 1" omnibus volume, Seven Seas Webtoons) Summary: In his past, Eunsan spent his days playing competitive ice hockey and going head to head with his rival and one of the best players out there, Ryu Ian. But twelve years later, Eunsan has hung up his skates and now works in sports marketing instead, away from the competition and away from Ian.

Or so he thought. Suddenly, an opportunity appears where Eunsan must reunite with Ian. Determined to keep this reunion brief, Eunsan tries to keep things strictly business—until Ian presents him with an offer he truly cannot refuse.

With the two men brought back together, will the fire between them reignite and erupt into something bigger? Or will old feelings lead to old wounds that can't be healed?

Short Story Collection audiobook Creators: Tōko Amekawa , Wan Hachipisu Narration: Sarah Gage Release Date: November 19 (Siren imprint) Summary: This handpicked selection showcases dozens of delightful tales, including tender moments between Arnold and Rishe not depicted in the main story and glimpses of characters who aren't often in the limelight. See what Oliver, Arnold's stalwart attendant, gets up to during his time off—and what his relationship is like with his lord's little brother. Peer into a world where Arnold and Rishe are nothing more than students at the same academy. A few tales even feature Rishe's past lives from the perspectives of those she was close to. In the longest story, written specifically for this collection, Rishe and Arnold go undercover…as a married couple! Will our heroine be able to keep her cool around her “beloved husband” long enough to avoid suspicion? Either way, it's bound to be amusing watching her try!

Title: The Dangers in My Heart – The Novel audiobook Creators: Kota Nozomi , Norio Sakurai , sune Narration: Clint Bickham , Katelyn Barr Release Date: November 26 (Siren imprint) Summary: Experience the world beyond the gaze of the story's usual narrator, Ichikawa Kyotaro–a dour teen hopelessly smitten with Yamada Anna, the prettiest girl in class. For the first time, fans can see events through the eyes of beloved side characters like the mischievous Moeko, a flustered Kanzaki, and even Yamada's mother. Plus, an exclusive story about the early days of Ichikawa and Yamada's relationship over summer break from a completely new perspective. These sweet, bite-sized stories are sure to satisfy longtime fans and newcomers alike!

Title: Beacon of Light in the Dark Sea audiobook Creator: Softcoral Narration: James Aaron Oh Release Date: December 17 (volume 1, Siren imprint) Summary: Humanity's hunger for resources has sent us where we were never meant to go--down into the crushing dark. The North Pacific International Undersea Station is a submerged labyrinth of labs, mining decks, and narrow living quarters where the sun never reaches.

Muhyeon, a dentist by trade, joins the station expecting routine work, but the eerie silence and the crew's increasingly unstable behavior quickly prove him wrong. From quirky to unsettling, every encounter makes one truth impossible to ignore: the danger isn't outside the station--it's already here.

Title: Led by Stars manga Creator: Abi Release Date: November 2027 (volume 1, Ghost Ship imprint) Summary: In the quiet town of Elwood, on the edge of the Great Dungeon of Dagonalia, former adventurer Arc works alongside Lily as a guild receptionist. But one day, a mysterious threat known only as the “Goblin Queen” appears, wiping out anything and everything that crosses her path while stealing women away. With danger looming over them, Arc must decide if he will take up his sword once more and embark on a deadly journey to protect the town—and most importantly, Lily. To Arc's surprise, Lily has been hiding something from Arc that could change everything between them!

Title: Melting Point manhwa Creator: Pibi Release Date: April 2028 ("Season 1" omnibus volume, Seven Seas Webtoons) Summary: In his past, Eunsan spent his days playing competitive ice hockey and going head to head with his rival and one of the best players out there, Ryu Ian. But twelve years later, Eunsan has hung up his skates and now works in sports marketing instead, away from the competition and away from Ian.

Or so he thought. Suddenly, an opportunity appears where Eunsan must reunite with Ian. Determined to keep this reunion brief, Eunsan tries to keep things strictly business—until Ian presents him with an offer he truly cannot refuse.
With the two men brought back together, will the fire between them reignite and erupt into something bigger? Or will old feelings lead to old wounds that can't be healed?

title: 3 Returning Anime That Will Make Winter 2027 Unforgettable
content:
2027 is almost here, and these three returning anime in the Winter season will make the new year even more exciting. The upcoming year is shaping up to be one of the most exciting years for anime, especially with so much already planned across the year. Multiple anime movies are scheduled to premiere, alongside several new anime series.

However, the year will also be exciting for anime returning with new seasons. Winter 2027 is already proving to be the biggest example of this, and in a particularly exciting way. These three anime, in particular, are returning with new seasons that promise an unforgettable blend of action and comedy.

3) Mashle: Magic and Muscles Season 3

Shonen Jump has had many series receive anime adaptations in recent years, but few have stood out quite like Mashle: Magic and Muscles . The anime first premiered in April 2023, with A-1 Pictures handling the adaptation, and its second season followed the next year. The series quickly proved to be a unique shonen anime, with its magical premise and the intrigue of muscles being involved in a world of magic making it stand out. Its two seasons demonstrated that not every shonen series has to be overly serious to deliver a fun narrative and keep audiences engaged.

The two seasons incorporated all the classic elements of a shonen series, perfectly highlighting what makes the genre so appealing. They featured the development of rivalries, formidable villains, and eventually a classic examination arc that many shonen series incorporate. The next season of Mashle: Magic and Muscles will continue the Divine Visionary Exam as villains have infiltrated the competition. The upcoming season promises to be just as fun and intriguing, with Mash continuing to keep up with the magical world through his own unique strength.

2) Sakamoto Days

Another quirky shonen anime series returning in Winter 2027 is none other than Sakamoto Days , Netflix’s biggest shonen anime series of 2025 . As a heavy action-comedy series revolving around assassins and family, it has built a strong foundation, especially thanks to the intriguing action sequences featuring its titular character. Sakamoto’s ability to adapt to his environment and use virtually anything around him makes for action that arguably no other shonen series can match. The first season laid the groundwork for the next major arc.

The upcoming season will see Shin and Sakamoto infiltrate the JCC, where assassins are trained, to uncover more information about the mysterious villain X, aka Slur, who has become a major obstacle in Sakamoto’s peaceful life. Arguably, the second season of Sakamoto Days could also become the most-watched anime of Winter 2027, especially considering that the manga is nearing its conclusion. Its growing momentum could push more fans to watch the new season as they look for a replacement for the manga.

1) One-Punch Man Season 3 Part 2

One-Punch Man Season 3 has been one of the most talked-about anime releases of the past year, introducing the highly anticipated Monster Association arc as Garou takes the spotlight and emerges as one of its strongest fighters. Meanwhile, the growing threat of the monsters has thrown the entire Hero Association into chaos, forcing its members to join forces and launch an expedition to defeat them. The first part of Season 3 established this conflict, but the second part is where the season will have to do the heavy lifting.

The highly anticipated second part of One-Punch Man Season 3 is set to premiere in January 2027, finally bringing the long-teased epic battle between Garou and Saitama to the screen. Fans have had their doubts about the anime adaptation, but the recently released trailer suggests that the upcoming episodes might not be entirely disappointing. One-Punch Man ‘s anime adaptation has been a controversial topic since Season 2, but the fact that the series continues to receive new seasons despite the criticism is something fans should be grateful for. If J.C. Staff manages to pull it off, Part 2 of One-Punch Man Season 3 won’t just be one of the most unforgettable anime releases of Winter 2027, but potentially of the entire year.

title: Live-Action Mashle: Magic and Muscles Film Reveals Cast, Director
content:
The staff of the live-action film of Hajime Kōmoto 's Mashle: Magic and Muscles manga announced with an early teaser video and a teaser visual on Thursday that Mackenyu Maeda is starring as Mash Burnedead, and Yūichi Fukuda (2026 Sgt. Frog film, live-action Gintama , Sakamoto Days , Under Ninja , Super Salaryman Mr. Saenai ) is directing the film.

This is a world of magic where magic is used for everything. But deep in the forest exists a young man who spends his time training and bulking up. He can't use magic, but he enjoys a peaceful life with his father. But one day, his life is put in danger! Will his muscular body protect him from the magic users who are out to get him? Powerfully trained muscles crush magic as this abnormal magical fantasy begins!

Warner Brothers and Fuji TV are overseeing the project, and CREDEUS is producing. TOHO will distribute the film.

The film will open on March 19, 2027.

Both Viz Media 's Shonen Jump service and Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service published the manga digitally in English. Viz Media is also releasing the manga in print.

The series launched in Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in Japan in January 2020, and ended in July 2023. Shueisha published the manga's 18th and final compiled book volume, as well as a fan book, in October 2023.

The anime adaptation's first season premiered in Japan in April 2023 and aired for 12 episodes. Crunchyroll streamed the anime as it aired, and it streamed an English dub . The second season premiered in January 2024 and aired for 12 episodes. Crunchyroll again streamed the series as it aired and streamed an English dub . Crunchyroll will stream Mashle: Magic and Muscles - Tri-Magicathalon Divine Visionary Final Exam Arc , the third season based on Hajime Kōmoto 's Mashle: Magic and Muscles manga, in January.The overall anime project is listed as a "complete" anime adaptation.

The franchise also includes several novels and two stage play adaptations .

Mashle: Muscle Puzzle , a smartphone puzzle game in the franchise, launched in April 2025.

title: Almost 30 Years Later, One Piece Finally Gives Sanji the Power He Needed the Most
content:
Warning: This article contains spoilers from the One Piece manga! One Piece ‘s Elbaph Arc is getting more intense than ever as the spotlight finally goes to Sanji with his exciting new power-up. The Elbaph Arc started in the manga over two years ago, and yet it never fails to surprise fans with some of the most exciting plot twists and thrilling battle sequences. This time, however, the anticipated moment is finally here as Sanji uses Conqueror’s Haki in Chapter 1197. For almost three decades, fans have been divided over the powers of Zoro and Sanji , Luffy’s most powerful allies. The two are neck and neck in terms of strength, with Zoro slightly taking the lead in terms of raw power and Sanji in speed.

However, the only reason why the debate was never settled until now was that Zoro awakened his Conqueror’s Haki in the Wano Country Saga, giving him a major advantage against the crew’s chef. It’s one of the most powerful abilities in the entire series that goes beyond any Devil Fruit power. Luckily for Sanji fans, the manga confirmed several months ago that the beloved character will also get the power everyone wanted. While it took the series longer than expected, Sanji’s Conqueror’s Haki awakening will go down as one of the most memorable scenes in Shonen history.

One Piece ‘s Sanji Awakens the Power He Desperately Needed

Even after almost 30 years, One Piece keeps expanding its power system , especially when it comes to Haki. Before the Elbaph Arc, Conqueror’s Haki was crucial to give fighters an edge in battles, but it was never a basis to guarantee someone’s victory. However, things changed significantly in the ongoing arc with the appearance of the Holy Knights. While they may be seemingly immortal, their only weakness is Advanced Conqueror’s Haki that a handful of fighters can wield. Among the Straw Hats, Luffy and Zoro were the only ones who stood a chance against the Holy Knights. However, Gaban determined that Sanji has what it takes to unlock this ability. As expected, in the latest Chapter 1197, he steels his resolve to be Luffy’s shield while Zoro continues to fight as their Captain’s sword.

Since Conqueror’s Haki can only be used by those who possess a strong will, it’s pretty obvious that someone like Sanji, who is known for his kindness, can unlock this ability. Sanji has been wandering the seas since he was a child after barely escaping his abusive family. As someone deemed a weakling by his family, he not only survived unimaginable ordeals but also became stronger than anyone ever thought he could. In the Elbaph Arc, he uses his Conqueror’s Haki for the first time against Killingham. While the scene is surely exciting, the fight is far from over, and it’s clear that Sanji does have a long way ahead of him before he can fully learn to use the powerful form of this ability.

Do you think Sanji finally unlocking Conqueror’s Haki means he can tap into his true potential? Are you excited to see him use this ability in future battles? Let us know in the comments below.

title: 5 Major Isekai You Can Only Watch on Crunchyroll
content:
While the current anime industry is heavily dominated by battle shonen such as Jujutsu Kaisen , it offers more than just one specific type or genre of story. Despite the popularity of the isekai genre, not many of them are critically acclaimed, which makes it even harder to find a good series to watch. This is especially true when the genre itself has so many categories, and each of them offers something unique that may or may not appeal to the audience. The industry is getting oversaturated with this genre, which is all the more reason why fans have a difficult time getting the right series to watch.

Luckily, Crunchyroll is one such platform where you can find just about any kind of anime show or movie. It’s the largest anime streaming service in the world with more than a thousand titles in its library. Every quarter, the platform keeps adding dozens of new shows to its expansive library, including new debuts and sequels. A majority of those titles aren’t available to stream anywhere else, including some of the biggest isekai series. If you’re looking for new isekai series to watch, Crunchyroll is your go-to platform where you can find these five incredible anime.

5) Release that Witch

Release that Witch is technically a donghua, a term used to describe Chinese animation series. The Chinese animation industry has been on the rise for the past few years, and a lot of the notable series end up on Crunchyroll. Among the donghua on the platform, Release that Witch is one of the most underrated ones, but it’s worth a watch for every adventure fantasy fan. One of the reasons why the series stands out is that it maintains a serious, grounded tone and skips out on cheap gags or exaggerated anime reactions. The story follows a modern engineer who transmigrates into a prince named Ronald Wimbledon and relies on logic and science instead of possessing some overpowered ability. Additionally, the story also steers away from the stereotypical portrayal of witches in fiction as women ostracized from everyone else. Instead, this series features how they are integrated into society as they use their powers for construction and engineering.

4) Lord of Mysteries

Based on the famous novel by Yuan Ye, better known as Cuttlefish That Loves Diving, Lord of Mysteries released its donghua in June last year. The stunning animation, captivating soundtrack, and the unique worldbuilding quickly drew fans in, and it became one of the most popular isekai of the year. The novel already had a global fan base before the donghua was released. This dark fantasy series is set in an alternate world similar to Victorian-era London but stands out for its distinct supernatural elements, advanced technology, and a mysterious cosmology not found in our world. The bizarre world is governed by mysterious forces called the Seven Churches and secret organizations that allow anyone to become powerful through potions and rituals. The story centers around Klein Moretti, a university graduate and an amateur detective, who performs a ritual after the accidental death of his friend, but somehow he ends up awakening as a supernatural being.

3) The Saint’s Magic Power is Omnipotent

If you want to take a break from action shows and magical battles, this is the perfect comfort isekai anime for you. Set in a fantasy world, the series not only offers slow-burn romance but also follows the female lead in her quest to save the world she has been summoned to. The anime adaptation of the novel wraps up the story in two seasons, making it a perfect show to binge-watch for the weekend. The story centers around Sei Takanashi, who was suddenly summoned to an alternate world along with another young girl. The summoning ritual was supposed to call upon one saint from another world, and it just so happened that the prince believed Sei wasn’t the chosen one. With nothing else left to do, she spends her days as a researcher at the Research Institute until her boring life takes a drastic turn after saving the commander of the Third Order of Knights, Albert Hawke.

2) Saga of Tanya the Evil

Based on the 2013 action fantasy light novel written by Carlo Zen and illustrated by Shinobu Shinotsuki, Saga of Tanya the Evil returned with an anime sequel in 2026 after making fans wait for over six years. This exceptional story stands out for following a ruthless protagonist who happens to be an amoral reincarnation of a cynical salaryman from modern-day Japan, reborn as a young girl named Tanya Degurechaff in a war-torn, alternate version of early 20th-century Europe. Despite being young, she is known for her selfish, pragmatic, and cruel actions that send shivers down the spines of her enemies. The story kicks off with the protagonist, who challenged Being X, a self-proclaimed God, to a battle of wits and ended up being reincarnated as a little girl in a war-struck world where magic is primarily used for military purposes. Now known as Tanya, the protagonist swears to climb through the ranks of the country’s military, but Being X still proves to be the biggest obstacle in her struggles to build a peaceful life for herself.

1) Re:Zero -Starting Life in Another World-

Not only is it one of the most famous anime exclusively available on Crunchyroll, but it is also one of the highest-rated isekai of all time. The anime series is based on the acclaimed light novel written by Tappei Nagatsuki and illustrated by Shinichiro Ootsuka. Two years after the novel debuted in 2016, the White Fox animation studio released the anime adaptation, which continues to return with new sequels. 2026 marks the 10th anniversary of the anime, and over all these years, four seasons have been released, as the story keeps getting more intense. The anime is often praised for exciting plot twists, unique worldbuilding, and thrilling action as it centers around Subaru Natsuki, an ordinary teenage boy. After leaving a convenience store one evening, he suddenly finds himself transported into another world. Equipped with the ability to return to time, Subaru tries his best to adjust to the new world while also dealing with any threat that comes his way.

Is there any series or movie you like that didn’t make it to the list? Let us know in the comments why your favorite isekai on Crunchyroll deserves the spotlight.

The anime series is based on the acclaimed light novel written by Tappei Nagatsuki and illustrated by Shinichiro Ootsuka. Two years after the novel debuted in 2016, the White Fox animation studio released the anime adaptation, which continues to return with new sequels. 2026 marks the 10th anniversary of the anime, and over all these years, four seasons have been released, as the story keeps getting more intense. The anime is often praised for exciting plot twists, unique worldbuilding, and thrilling action as it centers around Subaru Natsuki, an ordinary teenage boy. After leaving a convenience store one evening, he suddenly finds himself transported into another world. Equipped with the ability to return to time, Subaru tries his best to adjust to the new world while also dealing with any threat that comes his way.
